description: This file defines Redux slice for managing 'contents' state, including actions, selectors, and reducers for content blocks in a web application.

methods.name: updateContents
methods.description: Reducer to update the contents state with an array of ContentBlock objects, handling addition, update, and deletion.

methods.name: getContentsById
methods.description: Selector to retrieve all content blocks indexed by their IDs.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Selector to retrieve all content blocks as an array.

methods.name: getCardContents
methods.description: Selector factory that returns a selector to get content blocks associated with a specific card ID, ordered according to contentOrder.

methods.name: getLastCardContent
methods.description: Selector factory that returns a selector to get the last content block in a specific card.
